$comment: SAFE-7: the swear words and slurs a team's language filter masks in chat messages, captions, and polls. tools/gen_constants.dart copies the words into lib/core/constants.g.dart and functions/src/shared/constants.ts. Matching ignores case and takes whole words only: a word is a run of letters, and links are left alone. An entry ending in * also matches longer words that start with it, so add * only where no everyday word starts the same way (cock* would catch cockpit). The examples are checked by both the app's and the server's tests.
